column1: # Maltby T.W., Aasen A., Hammer M., Wilhelmsen O. (2025). Review of Experimental Data and Evaluation of Equations of State
# for Modeling Formation of Solid CO2 in CCS and Natural Gas Applications. Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 64(50), 24253-24263.
# doi:10.1021/acs.iecr.5c04028. CC BY 4.0 (stated on the article's first page). Local copy maltby-2025-iecr-64-24253.pdf
# (sha256 744c2ba3bab6a828ce233f1cb2be23101f0a61af84ad80182aace81baa9874e9). Transcribed from the PDF text layer (the
# publisher's PDF has one; columns aligned cleanly for these two tables).
# block T2 = Table 2, "Overview of the Experimental Data for the CO2 Mixtures", p. 24256: mixture, SFE type, reference
#   number(s) of the article's reference list, marker (a) = pressure assumed constant, (b) = pressure assumed equal to the
#   SVLE curve, year, Npoints, xCO2 range in % (NA for SVLE-locus sets), T range K, p range MPa. 47 rows.
# block T3 = Table 3, "Comparison of MAPD Values across Different EoS Models", p. 24257: MAPD in % of the equilibrium
#   temperature (eq. 8: predicted T at the measured composition and pressure), solid EoS = Trusler 2011 + erratum, fluid EoS
#   columns EoS-CG, GERG(-2008), tc-PR* (alpha refitted with sublimation data, their Table 1), PR, SRK, SAFT-VR Mie,
#   PC-SAFT, PCP-SAFT; kij regressed on the same VLE data for all EoS (SI Table SI.1). The last four rows are the
#   averages per SFE type and overall (each data set weighted equally). 37 data rows + 4 average rows. Table 3 has no rows
#   for the SVLE-locus sets without compositions (the NA rows of Table 2).
# Reference numbers (article list): 4 Sampson 2023; 19 Lovseth 2018; 41 Pikaar 1959 (thesis; two SVE sets); 42 Donnelly and
#   Katz 1954; 43 Davis, Rodewald, Kurata 1962; 44 Sterner 1961; 45 Kurata and Im 1971; 46 Agrawal and Laverman 1974;
#   47 Le and Trebble 2007; 48 Zhang 2012 (NTNU thesis); 49 Shen 2012; 50 Gao 2012; 51 Xiong 2015; 52 GPSA 1998;
#   53 ZareNezhad 2006; 54 Smith, Sonntag, Van Wylen 1963 (Adv. Cryog. Eng. 8, 162); 55 Sonntag, Van Wylen 1962
#   (Adv. Cryog. Eng. 7, 99); 56 Kurata 1974 (GPA RR-10); 57 Yakimenko 1975; 58 De Stefani 2002; 59 Zaitsev 1986;
#   60 Sobocinski and Kurata 1959; 61 Klemenc and Bankowski 1932; 62 Thiel and Schulte 1920; 63 Riva and Stringari 2018;
#   64 He 2022; 65 Souza 2020; 66 Lange 2015; 67 Jensen and Kurata 1971; 68 Fandino 2015.
# Sanity check: T2 ranges have min <= max in every row; T3 average rows lie within the spread of their block.
# Digits as printed, one sanity check, not re-verified (owner: not looking for 100 % correct data).
